deliberateDepartures.detail: Used the mandated common light palette instead of the reference purple palette; translucent palette-role fills supply the soft surfaces. Omitted reference pattern motif and export examples because the supplied briefs describe different facts.
Accent appears on both selectable seats because B and C are equally selectable; a single destination accent would misrepresent their relationship.
Long role labels wrap across two lines without abbreviation. Warning-colored return route distinguishes the conditional shortage path.
Dashed outgoing connector denotes the result still awaited, while the label explicitly states the waiting state.

font.actualRenderedFont: Not determined; editable SVG text uses the declared family. Font availability, fallback and glyph coverage depend on the viewing environment.

limitations: No browser or output raster rendering was performed. XML and exact-label checks verify source structure, not visual acceptance.
